It could be an issue with the size of the input data or the configuration of your hadoop cluster. Additionally it could be that some nodes are misconfigured and fail and all the data has to go through one or few nodes that are properly configured in additional attempts. It also helps if the data is partitioned in advance, which you can achieve with the function scatter.  I hope this helps


Antonio
